modelDescription: The 'Model P'™ featuring Cimarron's superior fit and finish has long been the most authentic and highest quality reproduction of the 1873 Colt®. Rugged and dependable inside, the new Model 'P'™ with Cimarron's Cowboy Comp® action eliminates weaknesses associated with the 19th century design of the 1873 Colt® single action.
